title: European Stroke Organisation (ESO) guidelines for the management of temperature in patients with acute ischemic stroke

recommendations.section: PICO1: In hyperthermic patients with acute ischemic stroke, does treatment of hyperthermia compared with no treatment of hyperthermia improve functional outcome and/or survival?
recommendations.classNote: ESO printed strength 'weak' with no direction ('?'); no recommendation made
recommendations.text: In patients with acute ischemic stroke and hyperthermia, we cannot make any recommendation for treating hyperthermia as a means to improve functional outcome and/or survival.

recommendations.section: PICO2: In normothermic patients with acute ischemic stroke, does prevention of hyperthermia with antipyretics compared with no prevention of hyperthermia improve functional outcome and/or survival?
recommendations.text: In patients with acute ischemic stroke and normothermia, we do not recommend routine prevention of hyperthermia with antipyretics as a means to improve functional outcome and/or survival.

recommendations.section: PICO3: In patients with acute ischemic stroke, does induction of hypothermia compared with no induction of hypothermia improve functional outcome and/or survival?
recommendations.text: In patients with acute ischemic stroke, we do not recommend induction of hypothermia as a means to improve functional outcome and/or survival.

sourceReview.scope: Source wording, grading and publication updates were compared at the available source depth. This is not certification of comprehensive current clinical guidance.
sourceReview.sourceAccess: Indexed original publisher full recommendation passages with adjacent qualifications; not entire source/supplements
sourceReview.currencyNote: Identified extraction defects have been repaired. Selected later evidence is labeled separately in dated current-evidence notes; absence of an update note does not establish comprehensive clinical currency.
